input.task: Recommend whether engineering should adopt a mandatory independent checker.
input.context: The evidence is complete and the decision is ready for a concise recommendation.
input.output_format: Executive memo led by one conclusion and non-overlapping support.

checks: Conclusion appears first and every point supports it.

input.task: Explore an unfamiliar incident and discover what questions should be asked.
input.context: Evidence is incomplete and no conclusion is defensible.

checks: No unsupported conclusion is presented.

input.task: Find why the same registry authentication failure returns in every update run.
input.context: One error signature repeated in four identical runs.
input.output_format: Evidence-backed causal chain and validation check.

checks: Every why follows from evidence.

stop_conditions: Stop at an actionable cause or broken evidence chain.

input.task: Explain an incident with unrelated database, DNS, and credential failures.
input.context: Telemetry suggests three independent causes.

checks: Independent causes are not forced into one chain.

stop_conditions: Stop before assigning one root cause.

input.task: Turn a vague request to improve release operations into a complete operating frame.
input.context: Owner, timing, location, approach, and effort are unknown.
input.output_format: What, why, who, where, when, how, and how-much frame.

checks: All seven questions are answered or marked unknown.

stop_conditions: Stop when the frame is complete.

input.task: Change one documented Node version from 22.3 to 22.4.
input.context: File, old value, new value, and validation are known.

checks: Old value absent; new value present.

input.task: Make contributor onboarding documentation better.
input.context: The intention is vague but success can be measured in one bounded run.

checks: A reviewer can determine completion objectively.

stop_conditions: Stop when the goal is measurable.

input.task: Discover whether users have an onboarding problem at all.
input.context: No honest success metric is known before discovery.

checks: Questions do not invent a target metric.

input.task: Improve a weekly dependency-update workflow through measured iterations.
input.context: The workflow repeats and each change can be tested on one package.
input.output_format: Plan, bounded run, evidence check, and next action.

checks: The next cycle follows measured evidence.

input.task: Choose one database vendor from three candidates for a one-time purchase.
input.context: Explicit weighted criteria exist and there is no improvement cycle.

checks: Scores follow predefined weights.

input.task: Assess whether the product should enter a new market.
input.context: Internal capabilities and external conditions both affect direction.
input.output_format: SWOT analysis and one strategic move.

checks: Internal and external factors remain separate.

input.task: Find why one deployment command fails with the same error every time.
input.context: One recurring operational failure is isolated.

checks: Each causal step cites evidence.

input.task: Describe a real migration project for a behavioral interview.
input.context: Situation, responsibility, actions, and observed result are known.

checks: Situation, task, action, and result are present.

stop_conditions: Stop after the result and lesson.

input.task: Recommend whether the company should adopt a new review policy.
input.context: The evidence supports a conclusion; a story is not requested.

checks: Every argument supports the recommendation.

input.task: Write a launch email that moves readers to one trial signup.
input.context: The message is persuasive and has one action.

checks: One credible benefit and one CTA.

input.task: Explain garbage collection neutrally to a beginner.
input.context: The content is educational and must not persuade.

checks: A beginner can explain the example back.

input.task: Explain distributed consensus so a beginner can reveal understanding gaps.
input.context: Plain language and one concrete example are required.

checks: Vague terms are explained and example is accurate.

input.task: Produce an expert-level protocol specification with formal terminology.
input.context: Advanced technical precision is required; simplification would lose meaning.

checks: All required formal terms remain precise.

stop_conditions: Stop when normative requirements are complete.

input.task: Set quarterly direction and measurable outcomes for the platform team.
input.context: The team needs one memorable direction and two to four outcome measures.
input.output_format: Objective, key results, and review cadence.

checks: Key results measure outcomes.

stop_conditions: Stop when objective and key results are reviewable.

input.task: Run a five-item release checklist once.
input.context: The task is already bounded and has no broader objective.

checks: All five items pass.

input.task: Plan migration of twelve dependent packages to a new API.
input.context: The deliverable needs safe, owned, reviewable batches.
input.output_format: Work packages with owners, dependencies, and validation.

checks: Every package is independently reviewable.

stop_conditions: Stop when packages are bounded and ordered.

input.task: Rename one exact configuration key in one file.
input.context: The change and validation command are fully specified.

checks: Old key absent and new key present.

input.task: Choose one queue service from four candidates.
input.context: Cost, reliability, latency, and operations have explicit weights.

checks: Recommendation matches weighted scores.

input.task: Reject any vendor that cannot meet one mandatory legal constraint.
input.context: One non-negotiable constraint decides the outcome.

checks: Only compliant vendors remain.

input.task: Build a twelve-method modular skill system and define measurable completion.
input.context: Components and dependencies must be separated before package goals are measured.

checks: Every package and integration path has checks.

input.task: Improve a repeated CI workflow, but first determine why one failure keeps returning.
input.context: The improvement cycle cannot be planned until the recurring cause is actionable.
input.output_format: Root-cause chain followed by a deferred improvement cycle.

checks: Cause is evidenced before cycle design.
